meta.description: A network audio player as a Home Assistant media player: power, volume, play and pause, and what is playing. Tested with the Hegel H400 amplifier through the hegel_streaming integration; any media player that meets the Ramka's requirements works.

hegel-h400.description: An integrated amplifier with a built-in network streamer that plays Spotify, Qobuz and Google Cast.
hegel-h400.does: Plays music from the network and from its inputs. Through the hegel_streaming integration Home Assistant switches it on and off, sets the volume, controls playback and reads what is playing.

shelly-pm-mini-gen3.description: A small power meter that sits in the wall box behind a socket, in series with its phase. It does not switch.
shelly-pm-mini-gen3.does: Measures the power, voltage, current and energy of what is plugged in, locally through the core shelly integration, without a cloud account. The now-playing view shows the player's draw and voltage from it.

now_playing.title: Now playing
now_playing.description: Report player state and available track and service details.

status.title: Player status
status.description: Report player state, source, volume and mute when provided.

mains.title: Mains readings
mains.description: Read power or voltage only from an explicitly mapped meter.
examples: What is the player power draw?

explain.title: About media
explain.description: Media reports playback and optional meter readings; it does not control playback here.
